positions.name: ProShares UltraPro Short QQQ
positions.catalyst: Thu Oct 15: TSMC beat-and-raise (Q3 NI NT$763B +69% y/y vs ~NT$746B est; Q4 rev guide $52.3-54.3B above consensus) yet TSM ADR -1.9% pre-mkt and chips extend a 4th day of selling: SOXL -8.1%, MU -4.1%, SNDK -4.6%, NVDA -2.0%, ASML -1.4%. MSCI Asia-Pac -2.8% (SK hynix heavy). Nasdaq-100 futures ~-1.1% vs Dow ~flat after hotter CPI; QQQ -1.2% pre-mkt (720.3 vs 728.95). SQQQ +3.6% pre-mkt (37.30 vs 36.00) - well under no-chase line.
positions.driver: Good-news-sold on the sector's bellwether is a classic distribution tell; tech-led weakness on top of hot CPI, higher yields and Hormuz oil risk. Chose SQQQ over SOXS because SOXS is already +8.0% pre-mkt (at the no-chase line) after a +11% Wed, and a broader -3x Nasdaq short keeps the same thesis with less snap-back risk from a capitulation bounce in chips. Beat SOXS (chase), SPXS (diluted, S&P only -0.3%), BITX/BTC-USD (BTC ~80.9k drifting lower, no catalyst), UNH/healthcare defensives (catalyst was Oct 13, stale).
positions.risks: Fourth day of a chip selloff - TSMC's strong guide could spark a dip-buy reversal intraday (Tue's SOXS fade is the template). AAPL +0.8% pre-mkt partially offsets QQQ. 3x daily decay; hard stop 33.57 (-10%).
